value.rationale: The theorem identifies a measurable macroscopic synchronization signature that distinguishes shared resetting from independently reset axes. It provides a sharp distribution-free clock optimization and uniquely identifies periodic schedules as the slowest approach to perfect two-axis extremal correlation, while revealing a universal clock-independent logistic shape statistic. The exact leading deficit and two-point clock attainability envelope are structural finite-size results, not a parameter renaming or isolated numerical value.
